140.text: This is the Shaman. Left-click on her directly to select her, or left-click on the Shaman Button on the Control Panel. Right-click when you want to deselect her.

78.text: I have created my Reincarnation Site and the settlement is nearly complete.

84.text: Your settlement is thriving, Shaman. Braves resting in Huts are one way of creating Mana. Mana gives you the power to cast spells and train Followers

85.text: Your tribe is small. Four Huts should breed enough Followers for you to attack the Dakini. Rest some Braves in your Huts and they will create Mana for your spells.

83.text: The Lightning Spell is a devastating weapon and much more powerful than Blast. It kills Enemy Followers, and sets fire to Trees and buildings.

82.text: You have received a Single Shot Landbridge spell. Use it to create a path from where your Shaman stands to the land on which it is cast. Cast it over water to create a causeway.

86.text: Shaman, you've stolen the Warrior Training Hut Plan! Build one to train Warriors ready for conquest.

87.text: Braves sent to a Warrior Training Hut become Warriors. Training uses Mana.

102.text: Now we must face the Matak Tribe. I sense many Warriors ready to stand against us. In my vision we are aided by magic from a Stone Head. There must be a way to reach it...
